title: The Culture Within: Towards Mechanistic Understanding of Cultural Reasoning in LLMs
reasoning: The paper introduces the CultureLens benchmark to evaluate how LLMs reason about cultural expectations, which involves societal values, normative expectations, and morality. The dataset applies the Schwartz value taxonomy (measuring values like benevolence, tradition, and universalism) and its extraction protocol explicitly identifies rules around 'religion', respect, and cultural propriety across 75 countries.
